name: pdfreader

name: borb

name: python-poppler

name: camelot-py
reason: Its documented API extracts PDF tables. The one-page control contains text but no table, so a meaningful valid table control and adapter are still needed.

name: tabula-py
reason: Its Java-backed table extraction needs a valid table control and a pinned local Java toolchain run; the text-only PDF control is insufficient.

name: pdftextract

name: pdf2txt

name: markitdown-pdf

name: PyPDF2

name: reportlab
reason: Its documented PDF API generates documents; no PDF-aware local input parser API was established.
